title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 7:1-12
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 7:1-12</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="primary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="7:1" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Do not</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">judge</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          so that you will not <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">be judged</char>, 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <verse number="2" /> because with the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">judgment</char> that you <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">judge</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          you will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">be judged</char>, 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a''">
          and with the measure that you <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">measure</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b''">
          it will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">be measured</char> to you. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="3" /> Why do you <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">see</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">the speck</char> in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">the eye of your brother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          but you don’t <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">perceive</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">the beam</char> in your eye! 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          <verse number="4" /> Or, how can you say to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your brother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          “Allow me <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="turquoise">to take out</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">the speck</char> from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your eye</char>.”
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          And look, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">the beam</char> is in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your eye</char>! 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          <verse number="5" /> Hypocrite! First <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="turquoise">take out</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">the beam from</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your eye</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          and then you can <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">see-clearly</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">the speck</char> in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">the eye of your brother</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="primary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="6" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Do not</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">give</char> what is holy to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">dogs</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          and don’t throw your pearls in front of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">pigs</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          so <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">they</char> don’t trample them with their feet, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          and turning around, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">they</char> will tear you apart. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="primary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="7" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ask</char> and it will be <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">given</char> to you, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">seek</char> and you will <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">find</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">knock</char> and it will be <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">opened</char> for you, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <verse number="8" /> for everyone who asks will receive, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          and the one who <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">seeks</char> will <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">find</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
          and to the one who <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">knocks</char> it will be <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="purple">opened</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="9" /> Or, what person is among you 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          who, when <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">their son</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">asks</char> for bread, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          will he <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">give</char> him a rock? 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary">
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          <verse number="10" /> Or, when he <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">asks</char> for a fish, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
          will he <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">give</char> him a snake? 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="primary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="11" /> So then, if you all are bad, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          but you know to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">give</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">good gifts</char> to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">your children</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          how <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">much more</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">your Father in the skies</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          he will <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">give</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">good things</char> to those who <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">ask</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="12" /> So then, everything you desire 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        that <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">people to do to you</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        so <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">also you do to them</char>; 
      </group>
      <group>
        for this is the <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">Torah and the Prophets</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
